title: Capturing the Soul: The Hermetic Art of Spagyrics
short_description: A 4-day immersion into the Hermetic art of Spagyrics, exploring the soul of plants through philosophy and hands-on laboratory practice. Learn essential oil distillation, aromatic waters, oleolites, and melites while discovering how plant essences become powerful tools for transformation and healing.
description:
Join us in Aljezur, Portugal, for a four-day immersion dedicated to the Soul of the plants — their anima, where the foundations of Spagyrics unfold through philosophy and practice.

This workshop offers a living introduction to the art and science of Spagyric extraction — a path that unites hands-on laboratory work with a deeper understanding of nature’s intelligence.

Through guided distillations, discussions, and reflections, we will explore how to capture the most subtle and volatile principles of life — the aromatic soul of the plants — and preserve them in forms that hold both beauty and vitality.

You will learn to work with:
• Essential oil distillation (complete extraction)
• Aromatic waters
• Oleolites (oil infusions)
• Melites (honey infusions)

This workshop serves as an introduction to Spagyric philosophy and practice, offering a tangible experience of the anima as the bridge between matter and spirit — the place where fragrance becomes medicine and transformation reveals the hidden virtues of nature.

[More Information](https://stan.store/kermesspagyrics/p/capturing-the-soul-the-hermetic-art-of-spagyrics)
